commit.message:
perf(entities): a scoped name search or detail reads only the entities it asks for (#6330) (#6410)

Under a tag filter, the entity list recomputed mention counts for every visible
entity in the bank before applying the name search (twice: total and page), and
the detail view did the same to keep one entity.

The shared visible-mentions query now takes the entity ids a read wants. While
they have at most FEW_POSTINGS (5000) postings it reads only their mentions,
finding inheriting observations with one GIN && probe on source_memory_ids
instead of unnesting every visible observation. Past the cap it runs the
unchanged query, because walking from postings loses badly on a broad search.
The visibility rule stays in one place for list, detail and graph.

300k memories, 20k entities, one tag scope, median of 5, main vs fix:
search one name 585 -> 58 ms, prefix of 100 names 659 -> 76 ms,
detail of a small entity 68 -> 4 ms; broad searches and entities past the cap
unchanged. Same rows and counts in every case.
